sourceRole: approved illustration; composition and identity reference
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create one finished printable coloring-book page for a four-year-old child, portrait 1024x1536. Input image is the approved chapter illustration: preserve recognizable character identity, relationships and action, while simplifying it for crayons. Bold smooth BLACK outlines on pure WHITE paper, pure white object interiors, large CLOSED easy-to-color spaces. Use only black and white: no color, grey, shading, hatching, stippling, gradients, pencil texture or large solid black regions. Tiny solid black pupils and nostrils only are fine. Render hedgehog spines as about 12-18 large scalloped/pointed clusters, not hundreds of hairs; render foliage as a few broad leaves. All important figures and fillable objects fit inside generous white margins. No border, lettering, title, numbers, logo, watermark or explanatory text. The composition should fill the portrait page generously, not a tiny drawing lost in blank paper. Cover adaptation: PinPin stands on the left lake bank holding his single slender tapered golden hedgehog spine (outline only), smiling toward the right. Enlarge him to about half page height. Preserve the lake and two large water lilies on the right; add just a simple distant treeline and one willow branch. Remove all title lettering completely, replacing the title area with white sky. No dense landscape detail.

review.notes: Main illustration is good but peripheral objects touch or cross page edges. Targeted margin/silhouette completion revision required.
